Satan also uses other means to come against mankind, such as deception and craftiness, disguising himself, temptation, condemnation, snaring, lying and stealing God’s word from us (Matthew 13:19). Christ being the image of God shows us that it is God working through Christ who is truly saving us. All of us, who have been saved by the gospel of Christ, should let the light of Christ shine through us into this dark world, that others may hear and be saved (Matthew 5:16). Thank you Jesus!
